thread:
Alex: FYI AcmePay wants a POC to replace MegaLLM. They said latency and prompt parity are blockers. Can we scope a minimal adapter?
Maria: OK — timeline? they want something live in 2 weeks for exec demo.
Sam: Two weeks is tight but doable for a smoke POC. Need test prompts, expected outputs, and infra for A/B.
Alex: I'll ask for a 20-row golden prompt set and their current MegaLLM calls. Also pricing question: they asked if per-token pricing maps 1:1 or if we have conversion math for batching/embeddings.
Jordan: Pricing note — hosted API charges per output token. If they care about strict cost-parity, we can show equivalent token accounting and a projection for their 1M tokens/mo. Quick calc: 1M input+output ~ convert 1:1 but batching reduces cost by X. I'll prepare a short slidedeck.
Sam: Technical blocker: tokenization differences + system prompt handling. MegaLLM uses a leading system token; our SDK treats instructions differently. We should implement a thin shim that rewrites the request:
Sam: ```
// MegaLLM request
POST /v1/generate
{
  "system":"You are bank assistant",
  "messages":[{"role":"user","text":"..."}]
}

// Adapter maps to Redwood chat API
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model":"redwood-rlc-1",
  "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are bank assistant"}, {"role":"user","content":"..."}]
}
```
Maria: Good. Also call out response-diff tolerance. AcmePay wants exact parity for templates. We should create a regression harness that flags token-level diffs > 3% and semantic regressions (BLEU/ROUGE or a quick embedding-sim threshold).
Alex: They also submitted the security questionnaire — uploaded to our Drive: https://redwood.company/drive/acmepay/sec-q-2026.pdf SecurityBot, any immediate flags?
SecurityBot: [automated] Received sec questionnaire (AcmePay). Highlights: must provide SOC2 cert date, data residency options (EU), KMS/HSM support, and subprocessor list.
Jordan: SOC2 is current; we have EU region + Private deployment option. KMS is available, HSM via enterprise add-on. I'll attach a short compliance checklist for the call.
Legal: We'll need the completed questionnaire back within 5 business days. Also flag: they require 90-day incident notification SLA — need CS review.
Sam: For the POC infra: propose a canary route to forward 10% traffic through the shim to Redwood hosted model and 90% to MegaLLM. Capture logs, latencies, and outputs for diffing. Can use our tracing header: x-redwood-trace.
Alex: I'll propose the canary + 1-week side-by-side eval, exec demo at end of week 2. Ask them for billing contact so Jordan can prepare an indicative pricing sheet (hosted vs dedicated).
Maria: Action items: 1) Acme to share 20 golden prompts + expected outputs 2) Sam to build adapter & regression harness 3) Jordan to prepare pricing + compliance summary 4) Legal to start questionnaire review.
Alex: I'll coordinate kickoff call tomorrow 11am PT. Ping me if you need pre-read. :thumbsup:
